description: Held-out (clean-room, Noûs for Roberto Locatelli, 2026-09-29). n10's payload (a non-integer number token) with `claimed_canonical` REMOVED. The number-domain boundary is evaluated before anything else about the canonical bytes (MANIFEST canonicalization; x402 compliance_fields «Verifiers MUST reject it before computing»), so the reason is number_domain_reject, not a complaint about the missing claimed bytes. Pins the order of checks the clean-room REPORT declares (number domain → canonicalization → digest).
